findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: convert_coordinates, similar_skies · Private data: local_eclipse · Public sink: rise_set_times, altitude_azimuth, observation_windows, moon_details, day_summary, seasons, time_scales, convert_coordinates, planetary_phenomena, local_eclipse, solunar_periods, body_positions, sky_now, angular_separations, celestial_events, longitude_series, similar_skies, resolve_local_time.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: convert_coordinates, similar_skies · Private data: local_eclipse · Public sink: rise_set_times, altitude_azimuth, observation_windows, moon_details, day_summary, seasons, time_scales, convert_coordinates, planetary_phenomena, local_eclipse, solunar_periods, body_positions, sky_now, angular_separations, celestial_events, longitude_series, similar_skies, resolve_local_time

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
